§3Optional piece - but this one is the reactor.§r
An octagon of diameter 7 + 2 x tier, walls twice the diameter tall, on a hemispherical shield dome. Its FRONT face carries the controller and the six sockets the silo itself uses.

§5WALLS + DOME BY TIER§r
  §9T1§r (9 wide)   520x Radiation Proof + 113x Tungstensteel Reinforced
  §9T2§r (11 wide)  812x Radiation Proof + 193x Tungstensteel Reinforced
  §9T3§r (13 wide)  963x Europium Reinforced + 105x Radiation Proof + 257x Iridium Reinforced
  §9T4§r (15 wide) 1,343x Europium Reinforced + 129x Radiation Proof + 381x Iridium Reinforced
  §9T5§r (17 wide) 1,667x Radiant Naquadah Alloy + 141x Radiation Proof + 497x Iridium Reinforced
§8The Radiation Proof count at T3-T5 is the three radiation band rings, which stay radiation proof at every tier.§r

§5FUEL PILLARS§r - 8 Reactor Fuel Pillar Frame BLOCKS make one pillar. Full count per tier:
  T1§9 45§r pillars (360 blocks) . T2§9 77§r (616) . T3§9 109§r (872) . T4§9 157§r (1,256) . T5§9 201§r (1,608)
Partial pillars run at partial output.

§5THE FRONT FACE§r - six sockets, one cell either side of the controller's column:
 §9 1x§r Input Bus (IV) §8- rods in, bottom fuel course§r
 §9 1x§r Output Bus (IV) §8- depleted rods out, same course§r
 §9 1x§r Input Hatch (IV) §8- feedwater, drum course§r
 §9 1x§r Output Hatch (IV) §8- waste water / exported steam, drum course§r
 §9 1x§r Silo Control Block §8- between them§r
 §9 1x§r Maintenance Hatch §8- beside the controller, pad level§r

§8Rod Loading Ports above the pillars are OPTIONAL - the rod bus feeds every pillar internally. A full set is 201 at tier 5 if you want them for hand-feeding.§r

[note]A plant built by a much older version of the mod may need §9/btsmigrate§r, run by a server operator beside the controller.[/note]
